question: Where can I find café within a 170 kilometers radius while heading from Wagner Hotel, New York, NY toward Johnsonburg Swamp Preserve, Johnsonburg, NJ?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.017294 40.705449)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.867494 40.980105)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.017294 40.705449)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.017294 40.705449)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Choc O Pain French Bakery and Café

answers.description: offers breakfast and lunch catering; breakfast and lunch served
